comment_regular: Oblivion TES cell-node visibility controller. Updates the six-bit node mask and applies AppCulled to loaded interior/exterior cell categories. Categories are identified by Oblivion's own console command as Actor, Marker, Land Quad, Water Quad, Static Quad, and Active Quad. ShadowPass temporarily hides Actor (0) and Water Quad (3), then restores their prior mask states. Fallout was consulted only afterward and corroborates the conventional TES::ShowCellNode name.
